aboutText: Doug McDonald has over 35 years of experience in carpentry and building, starting in New Zealand and later in London before settling in Melbourne. At DM Urban Projects, we serve Yarraville with a full range of carpentry services, from custom builds to renovations. Our commitment to quality and local expertise ensures every project is completed to the highest standards, making us a trusted choice for homes and businesses in the area.
servicesText: DM Urban Projects provides specialised carpentry solutions for residential and commercial clients in Yarraville. With 35 years of experience, we handle everything from small repairs to large-scale building projects, ensuring precision and durability in all our work.

services.title: Residential Carpentry
services.desc: Expert carpentry services for homes, including repairs, installations, and custom woodwork tailored to Yarraville households.
